collection: Track C reference speech source collection
notes: Each page was verified to expose an audio player, Download media control, and transcript.
Selection does not certify that every second is ideal delivery.
Select complete 20-40 second passages after listening; correct the transcript to match the selected audio.
Keep all excerpts and flawed variants of a source speech in the same dataset split.
Source attribution alone does not establish the rights of every recording; check the file-specific reuse terms before redistribution.
2026-10-14: two existing Reagan MP3 originals normalized; official Eisenhower Library recording downloaded. CDN failures recorded separately.
